verdict.rationale: Working Copy's Repository Agent is a conversational AI assistant that can browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That covers natural-language insight into repositories. Nothing shows the agent can open pull requests: the app's PR creation for BitBucket/GitHub/GitLab appears to be a manual feature, not something the agent does. missing for 10: evidence the agent opens pull requests, depth of the agent's analysis/insight features, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent.
